// Generator of gitlab-ci-oracle.json: what the Go build's repository.gitlab-ci
// reports for every case of gitlab-ci-cases.json and for the alias bombs below.
// It must see the package's unexported names, so it runs as a test of
// package checks. Kept as text; regenerate from the repository root with:
//
//	cp internal/checks/testdata/gitlab-ci-oracle.go.txt internal/checks/zz_oracle_test.go
//	go test ./internal/checks -run TestZZGitlabOracle -count=1 && rm internal/checks/zz_oracle_test.go
package checks

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/discovery"
)

type zzCase struct {
	Name  string            `json:"name"`
	Files map[string]string `json:"files"`
}

type zzResult struct {
	Name         string            `json:"name"`
	Files        map[string]string `json:"files"`
	Status       string            `json:"status"`
	ReasonCode   string            `json:"reason_code"`
	Reason       string            `json:"reason"`
	Findings     json.RawMessage   `json:"findings"`
	Limitations  json.RawMessage   `json:"limitations"`
	ContextTools json.RawMessage   `json:"context_tools"`
}

func zzBombs() []zzCase {
	var merge strings.Builder
	merge.WriteString(".l0: &l0 {}\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 12; i++ {
		refs := strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprintf("*l%d, ", i-1), 9)
		fmt.Fprintf(&merge, ".l%d: &l%d\n  <<: [%s]\n", i, i, strings.TrimSuffix(refs, ", "))
	}
	merge.WriteString("test:\n  script: make\n")
	var plain strings.Builder
	plain.WriteString("a0: &a0 [x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x]\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 12; i++ {
		refs := strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprintf("*a%d, ", i-1), 9)
		fmt.Fprintf(&plain, "a%d: &a%d [%s]\n", i, i, strings.TrimSuffix(refs, ", "))
	}
	// Just under the limit: 2^20 nodes is not reached.
	var small strings.Builder
	small.WriteString("a0: &a0 [x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x, x]\n")
	for i := 1; i <= 4; i++ {
		refs := strings.Repeat(fmt.Sprintf("*a%d, ", i-1), 9)
		fmt.Fprintf(&small, "a%d: &a%d [%s]\n", i, i, strings.TrimSuffix(refs, ", "))
	}
	return []zzCase{
		{"bomb-merge", map[string]string{".gitlab-ci.yml": merge.String()}},
		{"bomb-plain", map[string]string{".gitlab-ci.yml": plain.String()}},
		{"aliases-under-limit", map[string]string{".gitlab-ci.yml": small.String()}},
	}
}

func TestZZGitlabOracle(t *testing.T) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/gitlab-ci-cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []zzCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cases = append(cases, zzBombs()...)
	var out []zzResult
	for _, c := range cases {
		dir := t.TempDir()
		names := make([]string, 0, len(c.Files))
		for rel := range c.Files {
			names = append(names, rel)
		}
		sort.Strings(names)
		for _, rel := range names {
			p := filepath.Join(dir, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(c.Files[rel]), 0o644); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		proj, err := discovery.Discover(dir)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		res := gitlabCI{}.Run(context.Background(), &Input{
			Project: proj, Context: &proj.Contexts[0], OriginalPath: "/work/project", SnapshotDir: dir,
		})
		findings, _ := json.Marshal(res.Findings)
		limitations, _ := json.Marshal(res.Limitations)
		tools, _ := json.Marshal(res.ContextTools)
		out = append(out, zzResult{
			Name: c.Name, Files: c.Files, Status: string(res.Status), ReasonCode: res.ReasonCode, Reason: res.Reason,
			Findings: findings, Limitations: limitations, ContextTools: tools,
		})
	}
	// Include globs: what globRegexp matches. A long input is written as
	// prefix + unit repeated count times + suffix.
	type longText struct {
		Prefix string `json:"prefix"`
		Unit   string `json:"unit"`
		Count  int    `json:"count"`
		Suffix string `json:"suffix"`
	}
	expand := func(l longText) string { return l.Prefix + strings.Repeat(l.Unit, l.Count) + l.Suffix }
	type globCase struct {
		Pattern longText `json:"pattern"`
		Path    longText `json:"path"`
		Match   bool     `json:"match"`
	}
	short := func(s string) longText { return longText{Prefix: s} }
	var globs []globCase
	addGlob := func(pattern, path longText) {
		globs = append(globs, globCase{pattern, path, globRegexp(expand(pattern)).MatchString(expand(path))})
	}
	for _, g := range [][2]string{
		{"ci/*.yml", "ci/a.yml"}, {"ci/*.yml", "ci/sub/a.yml"}, {"ci/**/*.yml", "ci/a.yml"}, {"ci/**/*.yml", "ci/x/y/a.yml"},
		{"ci/**", "ci/x/y"}, {"ci/**", "ci"}, {"**/*.yml", "a.yml"}, {"**/*.yml", "x/a.yml"}, {"**.yml", "x/a.yml"},
		{"ci/?.yml", "ci/a.yml"}, {"ci/?.yml", "ci/ab.yml"}, {"ci/?.yml", "ci//.yml"}, {"ci/?.yml", "ci/ä.yml"},
		{"ci/ä*.yml", "ci/äb.yml"}, {"ci/ä*.yml", "ci/Ã¤b.yml"}, {"a.b", "aXb"}, {"a+b", "a+b"}, {"(a)", "(a)"}, {"[a]", "[a]"},
		{"a**/b", "a/b"}, {"a**/b", "ax/y/b"}, {"a**/b", "ab"}, {"**/", "/"}, {"**/", ""}, {"*", ""}, {"?", ""},
		{"ci/*.yml", "ci/a\nb.yml"}, {"ci/**.yml", "ci/a\nb.yml"}, {"ci/**/a", "ci/x\n/a"}, {"ci/?", "ci/\n"},
		{"a*b*c", "aXbYc"}, {"a*b*c", "abcabc"}, {"$x", "$x"}, {"^a$", "^a$"},
	} {
		addGlob(short(g[0]), short(g[1]))
	}
	addGlob(longText{Unit: "*a", Count: 30, Suffix: "*b"}, longText{Unit: "a", Count: 50000})
	addGlob(longText{Unit: "**/a", Count: 30, Suffix: "b"}, longText{Unit: "a/", Count: 30000})
	addGlob(longText{Unit: "?", Count: 300}, longText{Unit: "x", Count: 300})
	addGlob(longText{Prefix: "ci/", Unit: "*", Count: 2000, Suffix: ".yml"}, longText{Prefix: "ci/", Unit: "a", Count: 50000, Suffix: ".ym"})

	// The pinned schema's patterns on short and long hostile strings: what
	// Go's MatchString says.
	type patternCase struct {
		Pattern string   `json:"pattern"`
		Text    longText `json:"text"`
		Match   bool     `json:"match"`
	}
	var patterns []patternCase
	var schemaDoc any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(gitlabCISchema, &schemaDoc); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	var walk func(v any)
	walk = func(v any) {
		switch x := v.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			for k, e := range x {
				if k == "pattern" {
					if s, ok := e.(string); ok {
						seen[s] = true
					}
				}
				if k == "patternProperties" {
					if m, ok := e.(map[string]any); ok {
						for p := range m {
							seen[p] = true
						}
					}
				}
				walk(e)
			}
		case []any:
			for _, e := range x {
				walk(e)
			}
		}
	}
	walk(schemaDoc)
	var pats []string
	for p := range seen {
		pats = append(pats, p)
	}
	sort.Strings(pats)
	texts := []longText{
		short(""), short("a"), short("."), short("a/b"), short("x.yml"), short("ci/a.yaml"), short("$VAR"), short("pull"), short("$"),
		short("https://a.example/x.yml"), short("http://"), short("/x/"), short("a\nb"), short("a\n/b"), short("sha256-" + strings.Repeat("A", 43) + "="),
		short("2024-02-29T10:00:00+01:00"), short("x\v/y"), short("x /y"), short("ab_9"), short("1a"), short("a-b"),
		{Unit: "a", Count: 200000, Suffix: "/"}, {Unit: ".", Count: 200000}, {Unit: "a", Count: 200000}, {Unit: "/", Count: 200000},
		{Unit: "$", Count: 200000}, {Unit: "$a", Count: 100000}, {Prefix: "https://", Unit: "a", Count: 200000, Suffix: ".ym"},
		{Prefix: "https://", Unit: ".y", Count: 100000}, {Prefix: "/", Unit: "a", Count: 200000}, {Unit: "a/", Count: 100000},
		{Unit: "\n", Count: 200000}, {Unit: "x", Count: 200000, Suffix: ".yml"}, {Unit: "a ", Count: 100000}, {Unit: "pul", Count: 100000},
		{Prefix: "$", Unit: "w", Count: 300}, {Unit: "_", Count: 200000, Suffix: "!"}, {Unit: "2024-", Count: 50000},
	}
	for _, p := range pats {
		re := regexp.MustCompile(p)
		for _, tx := range texts {
			patterns = append(patterns, patternCase{p, tx, re.MatchString(expand(tx))})
		}
	}

	doc := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "the Go build at the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8 (Go 1.27.3)",
		"cases":        out,
		"globs":        globs,
		"patterns":     patterns,
	}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/gitlab-ci-oracle.json", append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
